name: alert
summary: An inline banner whose icon draws itself inside a halo, with an optional draining timer.
props: Card with a tone glow behind the icon, transparent with a hairline tone border, or filled with the solid tone. "accent-bar" is deprecated and renders as "soft".
First line. Without a title (and without actions) the alert uses the compact single-line layout.
One action: a tone pill under the text, or an inline pill on the right in the compact layout.
{ primary: { label, onPress }, secondary?: { label, onPress } }
Pill pair on the bottom row; primary is filled with the tone.
Custom icon (shown in the halo) or none.
Show a 28pt close button (44pt hit area) that collapses the alert.
Auto-dismiss. A hairline drains along the bottom edge; pauses while pressed or hovered.
Called when closed by the button or when `duration` runs out.
Notification haptic (success / warning / error) when the alert appears.
Style for the outer animated wrapper (its height collapses on dismiss).
behavior: On appear the icon outline draws, the glyph springs in and the halo ripples once. Dismissing collapses the height so content below glides up.
With duration set, a hairline drains along the bottom to show the time left. Pressing the alert pauses it.
The icon draw, glyph pop and halo ripple jump straight to their finished state.
Success, warning and danger alerts play the matching notification haptic when they appear; info stays silent.
The card has the alert role in a polite live region. The close button is labelled Dismiss and actions are buttons named by their label.
Hovering also pauses the auto-dismiss timer.
usage:
import { Alert } from '@/components/ui/alert';

<Alert
  variant="warning"
  title="Storage almost full"
  description="You've used 9.4 GB of your 10 GB plan."
  dismissible
/>
